evaluation_summary: Stonehaven is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a mission-critical product-search + personalization pipeline. They ran hosted-API POC to validate quality and now need deterministic capacity planning and contract-level SLAs. Primary focus: meet p95 latency SLOs for 8k-32k context models while keeping reserved GPU costs predictable. Team is sensitive to quantization quality regressions and wants quant-profile recommendations tied to throughput/cost tradeoffs.
sales_notes: Customer willingness to sign 12-24 month reserved capacity if we can guarantee p95 latency and provide clear GPU sizing guidance.
Preference for H100-grade inference for 32k context experiments, but open to mixed pool (H100 + A100) with routing rules by model size.
Procurement requires 3 vendor SOWs; engineering will run 2-week focused load tests on dedicated pool before procurement approval.
Legal pushing on EU data residency; proposed option: Regional dedicated pool + S3 residency controls in proposal.
SE ask: provide model-specific tuning guide (context length limits, quant profiles tested, recommended KV shard configs) as part of proposal.
use_case_summary: Primary use: product-search reranking + per-session personalization. Workload characteristics: lots of short queries (median tokens 40) with spikes during promotions (X4 baseline). Also periodic long-context personalization runs (user history, cart state) requiring 16k-32k context windows. Cost sensitivity moderate; they prioritize consistent latency over minimal unit cost for customer-facing flows.
